scenarios.name: damages-a-player-by-their-untapped-lands-at-the-start-of-their-turn
scenarios.why: Oracle: at the beginning of each player's upkeep, Power Surge deals X damage to that player, where X is the number of untapped lands they controlled at the beginning of this turn. p1 controls two Forests, tapped, and two Mountains, untapped, when p1's turn begins: X is the number of untapped lands as the turn began, 2, counted before the untap step untaps the Forests. p1 takes 2 at their upkeep.
